translation.title: Analgesic and Anti-inflammatory Adhesive patch
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for the analgesic and anti-inflammatory relief of osteoarthritis (degenerative arthritis), periarthritis of the shoulder, tendinitis and tenosynovitis, epicondylitis of the humerus (such as tennis elbow), muscle pain, and swelling and pain after an injury.
translation.usage: Peel off the release liner from the medicated surface and apply the patch to the affected area twice a day. Wipe the sweat from the application site before use.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine in the following cases: people who are hypersensitive to this medicine; people who have or have had aspirin-induced asthma (asthma attacks caused by non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs); damaged skin or mucous membranes; eczema; areas of rash. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before using this medicine in the following cases: bronchial asthma; pregnant women; children; elderly people. Stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist if any of the following occur: occasional redness (congestion and reddening); rash; drug eruption; itching and a burning sensation; contact dermatitis; asthma attacks (dry rales (a bubbling sound), wheezing, difficulty breathing). Store at room temperature, protected from moisture and light.
